channel.title: The Forgotten Web
channel.description: Old essays, blogs, forum posts, and useful web pages selected by a human and linked back to source.

item.title: The Zoomquilt
item.description: A collaborative painting that zooms forever through 46 hand-painted worlds, made in 2004 and still running in the browser. Originally published: October 2004 (exact day unspecified). Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-10-28.

item.title: Cameron's World
item.description: A sprawling, clickable collage of rescued GeoCities GIFs, homemade dreams, and personal-web oddities. Originally published: August 2015 (exact day unspecified). Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-10-21.

item.title: Mike Caulfield - The Garden and the Stream: A Technopastoral
item.description: A durable argument for gardens, paths, and tended knowledge instead of endless streams. Originally published: Sat, 17 Oct 2015 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-10-07.

item.title: Warner Bros. - Space Jam Official Site
item.description: A still-live 1996 promotional site: starfields, image maps, table layouts, and a movie lobby built by hand in HTML. Originally published: Fri, 15 Nov 1996 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-09-30.

item.title: Justin Hall - Justin’s Home Page
item.description: A dorm-room personal homepage from January 1994, preserved before profiles replaced places. Originally published: Thu, 27 Jan 1994 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-09-23.

item.title: Rick Levine, Christopher Locke, Doc Searls & David Weinberger - The Cluetrain Manifesto: 95 Theses
item.description: Markets as conversations, written before the social web was turned into engagement plumbing. Originally published: Mon, 01 Mar 1999 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-09-16.

item.title: Eric S. Raymond - The Cathedral and the Bazaar
item.description: A firsthand map of open-source collaboration before it became corporate infrastructure and content-marketing wallpaper. Originally published: Tue, 27 May 1997 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-09-02.

item.title: Olia Lialina - My Boyfriend Came Back from the War

item.title: J. R. Carpenter - A Handmade Web

item.title: Doc Searls & David Weinberger - World of Ends
item.description: The internet as a world of edges, not gates — and a useful antidote to every platform that later tried to become the middle. Originally published: Thu, 20 Mar 2003 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-06-19.

item.title: Mark Bernstein - Hypertext Gardens: Delightful Vistas
item.description: The web as a landscaped place of paths, surprise, and authored structure instead of navigation plumbing. Originally published: Thu, 01 Jan 1998 00:00:00 +0000. Added to The Forgotten Web: 2026-06-16.

item.title: Olia Lialina - A Vernacular Web
